data.narrative:
Kairos Power is a late-stage nuclear energy company founded by Mike Laufer, Edward Blandford, and Per Peterson, having raised $500M+. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 7 private peers, with notable private competitors including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised of $500M as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for late-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $600M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points at the same stage and valuation tier within nuclear energy; although six same-sector peers exist, filtering by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier yields fewer than the three datapoints required for robust median analysis.

The triangulated valuation range supported by this analysis is $510M to $690M, with a median of $600M, derived from a single method. The primary uncertainty stems from the limited ability to anchor against peer multiples in this nascent, heterogeneous subsector. Meaningful valuation refinement would require either greater transparency on comparable late-stage nuclear valuations or forward revenue/capacity data for Kairos Power and peer set firms.
